release_notes:
Patch Release - Manual Flowchart and Bug Reporting Enhancements.

New Features:
  - Flowchart Integration: Added a beautiful system data flow and architecture flowchart to both the HTML user manual and compiled Word manual (automatically embedded as a high-resolution PNG).
  - Diagnostics & Bug Reporting: Updated the Help → Report Issue... dialog to include an 'Include system & session diagnostics' checkbox (enabled by default) so users can choose whether to securely attach telemetry metrics, OS version, and Python/Qt context to speed up bug resolution.
